subject: [video] WP05 milestone: glue + stub suite green (616 checks), iOS object compiles
body: Implemented vt/n2avc_vt.h/.c: CMBaseObject/VTVideoEncoder vtable, all 29 properties (used+stored+read-only), supported-property dictionary, lazy n2avc_open, AVCC sample buffers with timing/attachments, one emit per frame incl. error paths, finalize. Host: 'bash gpu/video/vt/test_avc_vt/run_tests.sh' -> N2TEST WP05 PASS 616/616 (308 ASan+UBSan against stub_n2avc, 308 TSan with two sessions on two threads). The real-encoder 10-frame ffmpeg decode test is in t_avc_vt.c and runs automatically once avc/*.c exists. iOS: clang --target=arm64-apple-ios16.0 ... -c vt/n2avc_vt.c -> zero warnings. Next: STATUS.json, then watch for WP03's avc/ and run the real path.
